verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect is documented as the way to build a platform or marketplace that moves money between multiple parties, and it can collect customer payments and automatically pay out a portion to sellers or service providers. Connected accounts are a first-class concept, and Stripe maintains a connect-required-verification-information skill, which hints at seller verification during onboarding. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the seller onboarding flow (account creation and KYC UI), detail on split-payment mechanics and per-seller payout scheduling, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of Connect.
